speaker: Doctor
text:
Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragm, no acute infiltrates.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the X-ray results; the hyperinflation and flattened diaphragm suggest air trapping. Does your breathing difficulty improve when you sit up or lean forward? Additionally, have you noticed any swelling in your ankles or waking up at night gasping for air?

speaker: Patient
text: My breathing gets a little easier when I sit up, but the ankle swelling has become more noticeable lately. I haven't been waking up gasping for air, just feeling generally short of breath with my usual activity. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with acute decompensation and history of ischemic stroke.
